_: Notice types the merged rail-and-bus feed is allowed to raise. No ERROR may
appear here - an error fails the build whatever this file says. Each entry
needs a reason, and an entry that stops occurring has to be removed.
This is the baseline worth watching. The merge renumbers every service,
route and trip id across two feeds, and a dangling reference from that is
exactly what a hand-written fixture cannot produce and a validator can see.
It has already earned its place: it caught the merged feed calling at
location_type=1 stations, which the merge produced by moving every call from
a platform onto the station above it.

reasons.big_gap_in_service: inherited from the rail feed, which is a slice of a refresh and so has sparse services
reasons.missing_bike_allowance: inherited: bikes_allowed is 0, meaning no information, in both inputs
reasons.missing_recommended_file: feed_info.txt. Neither input has one the merge could carry, and a merged feed has no single publisher to name
reasons.mixed_case_recommended_field: inherited from the rail feed, whose MSN station names are upper case
reasons.service_extends_far_in_the_future: inherited: a calendar running to 2099 in the DTD source
reasons.transfer_distance_above_2_km: inherited: the rail feed's fixed links really are that long
reasons.transfer_with_suspicious_mid_trip_in_sea: inherited: a DTD join or split anchors a coupling part way along a trip on purpose
reasons.unexpected_enum_value: route_type 714, rail replacement bus, from the extended route types the validator does not know
